# qa-kit for Codex

qa-kit is a QA automation plugin for coding agents. It keeps a long-term memory for each web
app (modules, routes, test conventions, selectors, known bugs, flaky tests, decisions) and
global lessons shared across apps, and guides the agent through a disciplined Playwright
workflow: map the app, design test cases from requirements, write specs in the project's own
conventions, run only when asked, triage failures, and save what was learned.

This package contains six skills (qa-automation, qa-explore-app, qa-test-cases, qa-playwright-author, qa-run-triage, qa-memory); the qa-kit MCP server with 11 tools for memory, the test-case index, coverage gaps, and run history; hooks that load the memory digest at session start and record Playwright runs automatically.

## Install

```
codex plugin marketplace add MahmulP/qa-kit
then install qa-kit from /plugins (CLI) or the Plugins Directory (app), and trust its hooks in /hooks
```

Then open a web app repository and ask the agent to "set up qa-kit for this app".
Everything runs locally; qa-kit sends no data anywhere (see https://github.com/MahmulP/qa-kit/blob/main/PRIVACY.md).
